about: Owner of a small dental lab making crowns, bridges, veneers and dentures for local practices

messages.subject: Vorschau für Veneers?
messages.body:
Liebe Frau Fischer,

wir haben immer mehr Patienten, die vor einer Veneer-Behandlung sehen möchten, wie das Ergebnis aussehen wird. Bieten Sie so etwas wie ein Mock-up an, also eine Vorschau aus Kunststoff, die wir direkt im Mund zeigen können?

Viele Grüße
Anja Weber

messages.subject: Re: Vorschau für Veneers?
messages.body:
Liebe Frau Weber,

im Moment leider noch nicht, aber ich schaue mir das gerne an und melde mich.

Viele Grüße
Lena Fischer

messages.subject: Try-in previews?
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Quick question: do you do try-in previews for smile makeovers? Patients want to see the new smile before they commit to eight veneers. The lab at my old practice printed a temporary shell from the wax-up and it closed a lot of cases for us.

Diego

messages.subject: Re: Try-in previews?
messages.body: Hi Diego, good question. Not yet, but let me find out what it would take. Lena

messages.subject: Your 60-day trial of the LF-2
messages.body:
Dear Lena,

Thanks for stopping by our booth. We'd like to offer you a 60-day trial of our LF-2 desktop printer with our new tooth-colored mockup resin, free of charge. All we ask is feedback at the end of the trial. Installation and training take half a day.

Shall I book a date?

Best,
Hannah Lindqvist
Layerform 3D

messages.subject: Re: Your 60-day trial of the LF-2
messages.body: Hi Hannah, thanks, sounds interesting. Not sure we have the time this autumn, I'll get back to you. Lena

messages.subject: Info for our quality audit
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Our practice has its quality audit in early December. For every lab we work with, the auditor wants a list of the materials used for our cases, with their CE marks, and a short description of how you trace a batch back to a patient case. Could you send us something by November 27?

Thanks so much,
Ingrid Svensson
Practice manager, Lakeside Dental

messages.subject: Déclaration de conformité et numéros de lot
messages.body:
Bonjour Madame Fischer,

Dans le cadre de notre certification, nous devons garder pour chaque prothèse la déclaration de conformité et la liste des matériaux utilisés avec leurs numéros de lot. Pourriez-vous nous préparer un document type que nous pourrions joindre à chaque dossier patient ?

Bien cordialement,
Dr Élodie Garnier

messages.subject: Re: Déclaration de conformité et numéros de lot
messages.body:
Bonjour Docteur Garnier,

Bien reçu, je m'en occupe et je reviens vers vous.

Cordialement,
Lena Fischer

messages.subject: Service visit 5-axis mill
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Confirming the annual service and spindle replacement on your 5-axis mill: our technician is on site Tuesday November 17 to Thursday November 19. The machine is out of use for those three full days, with a calibration run at the end of Thursday.

Please reply to confirm.

Regards,
Felix Brandt
MillTech Service

messages.subject: Veneers case 5208, tight deadline
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

The six upper veneers for case 5208: the patient flies out for her wedding on Saturday November 21, so we need to seat them on Friday the 20th at the latest. The final scan comes to you Monday November 16. Can you make that work?

Sophie

messages.subject: Re: Veneers case 5208, tight deadline
messages.body: Hi Sophie, yes, that should work. We'll have them back to you by Thursday evening. Lena

messages.subject: Your courier rates from December 1
messages.body:
Dear Lena,

As your account manager I wanted to let you know personally that our rates change from December 1, 2026: a standard pickup goes from 9.50 to 12.00 and a same-day return from 14.00 to 18.00. Fuel and wages have gone up a lot this year.

Thank you for your understanding.

Karen Doyle
SwiftDent Courier

messages.subject: Cargo-bike courier for your lab
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

I run Pedal Post, a cargo-bike courier in the city center. A few dental practices already use us for their lab runs. We do fixed routes: 8.00 per stop, or 950 a month flat for up to 150 stops, same-day returns included.

Happy to do a free trial week if you're curious.

Omar Haddad
Pedal Post

messages.subject: Hip date
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

The hospital called: the new hip is booked for Tuesday November 24. They say I'll be home after three or four days, but no driving for six weeks, and Gisela is at her sister's until December. Don't worry, I'll manage somehow.

Dad

messages.subject: time off!!
messages.body: Hey! I finally got my leave approved: I'm free from November 25 to December 6. I was thinking of coming to stay with you for a few days, maybe the first week of December? Love, C

messages.subject: gutted
messages.body: Argh, The Silver Hollow sold out before the page even loaded. 21st of November at the Old Gasworks, the only date near us. Gutted. Anyway, pasta tonight?

messages.subject: spare tickets
messages.body: Hey Lena, Mia and I can't make the Silver Hollow gig on Saturday November 21 after all, her parents are visiting. Two tickets going spare at face value, 45 each. Know anyone? Jonas

messages.subject: Re: gutted
messages.body: Oh no, sorry love. Pasta yes, I'll bring wine.

messages.subject: Remake crown 36, case 4980
messages.body: Hi Lena, please remake the crown on 36 for case 4980. The distal margin is open on the try-in. New scan attached. Thanks, Martin Keller

messages.subject: Re: Remake crown 36, case 4980
messages.body: Hi Dr. Keller, sorry about that. The remake goes out Tuesday, no charge. Lena

messages.subject: 2027 price list type IV stone
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Martin from Gypsumworks here. Attached our 2027 price list for type IV die stone. If you order 200 kg or more per quarter we can do 8% off. Happy to drop off samples.

Best,
Martin Keller
Gypsumworks

messages.subject: Cracked denture
messages.body: Hi Lena, Mr. Novak's upper denture cracked across the midline after two months. Can you repair or remake it? We'll send it over with the courier. Ruth, Birchwood Dental

messages.subject: Novak denture fracture
messages.body: Hi Lena, sending from my own email because our practice server is down. Did you get my note about the Novak upper denture fracture? He's a bit upset, so the sooner the better. Ruth

messages.subject: Re: Novak denture fracture
messages.body: Hi Ruth, yes, got it. We'll reinforce and repair it within two days of receiving it. Lena

messages.subject: Order confirmed: Aurora Multilayer
messages.body: Dear Ms Fischer, your order of 10 Aurora Multilayer zirconia discs (A2, 98 x 20 mm) is confirmed and ships tomorrow. Kind regards, Zirkon Nord

messages.subject: Your reservation is confirmed
messages.body: Dear Ms Fischer, your room for the dental technology congress is confirmed: 2 nights from February 11, 2027, single room, breakfast included. We look forward to welcoming you at the Aurora.

messages.subject: MDR: what changes for labs next year
messages.body: This month: the new documentation rules for custom-made devices, what auditors will ask practices for, and how three labs set up batch tracing. Plus: pricing survey results.

messages.subject: Reminder: documentation duties for custom-made devices
messages.body: Regulatory alert: practices and labs must keep a statement for every custom-made device. Download our template pack for subscribers.

messages.subject: Christmas turnaround
messages.body: Hi Lena, what are your turnaround times over Christmas? We have a few retainers we'd like before the new year. Hugo

messages.subject: Holiday closing
messages.body: Hello Lena, when is the lab closed over the holidays, and what's the last day we can send new cases? Thanks, Beth, Oakwood Dental

messages.subject: Kurier heute nicht gekommen
messages.body: Hallo Frau Fischer, der Kurier war heute nicht bei uns, die Abdrücke für den Fall Bauer liegen noch hier. Können Sie nachfragen? Gruß, Nina Hoffmann

messages.subject: No pickup today
messages.body: Hi Lena, the courier didn't show up today. Two cases are waiting at the front desk. Beth

messages.subject: Missed pickups yesterday
messages.body: Dear Lena, apologies: our driver on route 3 fell ill yesterday afternoon and we couldn't cover in time. All missed pickups were collected first thing this morning and are on their way to you. Karen, SwiftDent

messages.subject: Re: Kurier heute nicht gekommen
messages.body: Hat sich erledigt, heute Morgen wurde alles abgeholt. Danke! Nina Hoffmann

messages.subject: Lunch-and-learn: layering ceramics

messages.subject: Cerafin session
messages.body: Hi Lena, can I go to the Cerafin layering session on Thursday? Dr. Weber's assistant asked me about layering last week, maybe she'd want to come too. Marco

messages.subject: Night guard, hard acrylic
messages.body: Hi Lena, I need a hard acrylic night guard for a patient who grinds heavily. Upper arch, scan attached. No rush, within two weeks is fine. Paul

messages.subject: Re: Night guard, hard acrylic
messages.body: Hi Paul, received, we'll have it to you within ten days. Lena

messages.subject: Following up on your checkup
messages.body: Dear Ms. Fischer, following your checkup, Dr. Hale recommends a night guard for the grinding wear we saw on your molars. Please call or reply to schedule the impression appointment. Kind regards, Riverside Dental Care

messages.subject: Scanning training for my team
messages.body:
Hi Lena,

Could you run a session for my team on scanning the way your lab likes it? Ideally just for us. We're trying to get ahead of the practice across the square, so I'd rather keep it quiet.

Amelia Ross
Hillcrest Dental

messages.subject: Re: Scanning training for my team
messages.body: Hi Amelia, happy to. Let me look at dates and come back to you. Lena

messages.subject: Scanning workshop?
messages.body: Hi Lena, would you do a scanning workshop for our staff? I hear Hillcrest is going fully digital and we don't want to fall behind. Owen, Square Dental

messages.subject: 2027 price list for Nguyen and Vidal
messages.body: Hi Lena, Dr. Nguyen and Dr. Vidal both asked for the 2027 price list. I've attached the PDF and drafted both emails. Just say go and I'll send them. Priya

messages.subject: Farbe Krone 21
messages.body:
Liebe Frau Fischer,

die Krone auf 21 (Fall Schmitt) wirkt im Mund etwas zu grau. Die Patientin wünscht sich eher A1. Könnten Sie die Farbe noch anpassen?

Viele Grüße
Anja Weber

messages.subject: Re: Farbe Krone 21
messages.body:
Liebe Frau Weber,

ja, gerne. Schicken Sie die Krone bitte zurück, wir passen sie auf A1 an. Sie ist in zwei Tagen wieder bei Ihnen.

Viele Grüße
Lena Fischer

messages.subject: Re: Farbe Krone 21
messages.body: Wunderbar, danke! Der Kurier bringt sie heute Nachmittag.

messages.subject: Neuer Fall: Teilprothese
messages.body: Hallo Frau Fischer, anbei die Abdrücke für eine Modellgussprothese im Unterkiefer, Fall Berger. Wann könnten wir die Gerüstanprobe machen? Gruß, Nina Hoffmann

messages.subject: Re: Neuer Fall: Teilprothese
messages.body: Hallo Frau Hoffmann, das Gerüst ist in acht Arbeitstagen fertig für die Anprobe. Viele Grüße, Lena Fischer

messages.subject: Question sur la facture
messages.body:
Bonjour Madame Fischer,

Sur la facture de septembre, le bridge du dossier Lefèvre apparaît deux fois. Pouvez-vous vérifier ?

Merci,
Dr Garnier

messages.subject: Re: Question sur la facture
messages.body:
Bonjour Docteur Garnier,

Vous avez raison, c'est une erreur de notre part. Je vous envoie une facture corrigée aujourd'hui.

Cordialement,
Lena Fischer

messages.subject: ¿Qué tal?
messages.body: ¡Hola prima! Hace mucho que no hablamos. Aquí todo bien, los niños ya están en el cole y yo con mucho trabajo. ¿Vienes a vernos en primavera? Un beso, Lucía

messages.subject: Re: ¿Qué tal?
messages.body: ¡Hola Lucía! Qué alegría. Sí, estamos pensando en ir en Semana Santa con Sam. Te cuento pronto. Besos, Lena

messages.subject: Consulta apartamento Semana Santa
messages.body:
Buenas noches,

¿Tienen un apartamento para dos personas del 25 de marzo al 1 de abril de 2027? Si es posible, con terraza.

Gracias,
Lena Fischer

messages.subject: Re: Consulta apartamento Semana Santa
messages.body:
Hola Lena,

Sí, tenemos un apartamento con terraza para esas fechas, 95 euros por noche. Para confirmar necesitamos un depósito del 30%.

Un saludo,
Apartamentos Mar Azul

messages.subject: CAD software update
messages.body: Hi Lena, the CAD update came out today. New tooth library and faster nesting. OK if I install it Friday after the last mill run? Marco

messages.subject: Re: CAD software update
messages.body: Yes, go ahead. Make a backup first please.

messages.subject: Vacation request
messages.body: Hi Lena, could I take December 14 to 18 off? My brother is getting married. Priya

messages.subject: Re: Vacation request
messages.body: Of course, congratulations to your brother! Approved.

messages.subject: Q3 VAT

messages.subject: Re: Q3 VAT
messages.body: Hi Grace, all uploaded to the portal just now. Lena

messages.subject: Lease renewal
messages.body:
Dear Lena,

Your lease on unit 4 ends January 31. We'd be glad to renew for three years at a 3% increase. Let me know if you'd like the draft.

Best regards,
Robert Hayes

messages.subject: Re: Lease renewal

messages.subject: Re: Lease renewal

messages.subject: Custom abutment 46
messages.body: Hi Lena, I need a custom titanium abutment and a zirconia crown on 46, implant scan body attached. Can I have it in two weeks? Diego

messages.subject: Re: Custom abutment 46
messages.body: Hi Diego, two weeks is fine. Lena

messages.subject: Retainers x4

messages.subject: Re: Retainers x4

messages.subject: Bridge 13-15 remake

messages.subject: Re: Bridge 13-15 remake

messages.subject: Liability insurance renewal

messages.subject: Re: Liability insurance renewal

messages.subject: Re: Liability insurance renewal

messages.subject: Application: dental technician
messages.body:
Dear Ms Fischer,

I saw your job post for a dental technician. I have four years of experience in ceramics and CAD design, mostly crowns and veneers. My CV and a portfolio are attached.

Kind regards,
Jana Novotná

messages.subject: Re: Application: dental technician

messages.subject: Re: Application: dental technician

promises.what: find out what try-in previews would take
get back about the printer trial
deliver the case 5208 veneers by Thursday November 19
send the remake crown on Tuesday at no charge
repair the Novak denture within two days of receipt
deliver the night guard within ten days
come back with dates for a scanning session

opportunities.what: Dr. Weber and Dr. Alvarez both ask for veneer previews patients can try in, and Layerform offers a free 60-day trial of a printer with mockup resin. Take the trial and offer a mock-up service to both practices.

Lakeside Dental's auditor and Dr. Garnier's certification both need the lab's materials list with CE marks and batch tracing. Write one materials and traceability document that serves both (Lakeside's due November 27).
The mill is out of use November 17-19 for service, but the case 5208 veneers scanned November 16 were promised for Thursday the 19th. Mill them another way or move the service.
SwiftDent raises pickups from 9.50 to 12.00 on December 1; Pedal Post offers 8.00 per stop or a flat monthly rate with a free trial week. Compare costs and trial the cheaper courier before the rise.
Dad's hip surgery is November 24 and he can't drive for six weeks with Gisela away; Clara is free November 25 to December 6. Plan Clara's stay around helping Dad when he comes home.
Sam missed out on Silver Hollow tickets for November 21; Jonas has two spares for that show. Buy Jonas's tickets for Sam.

traps.what: Dr. Martin Keller the dentist and Martin Keller the gypsum sales rep are different people.
The two denture fracture reports are Ruth writing from the practice and from her own address about the same case.
Aurora is both a zirconia product and the congress hotel; unrelated.
The custom-device documentation theme appears in two newsletters; only bulk.
Two practices asking about holiday turnaround are already covered by an open to-do to send the schedule to all practices.
Two practices reported a missed courier pickup; SwiftDent explained and everything was collected the next morning.
The Cerafin layering session and Marco's request were for September 24, long past.
A patient's night guard order (work) and the owner's own dentist recommending a night guard (personal) must stay apart.
Rival practices Hillcrest and Square Dental both want scanning training; Hillcrest wants it private, so a joint session would expose each.
Priya already drafted the price list emails for both practices; she only needs a go.
